name: homeland-discord-bot
description: HOMELAND Discord bot - Week 1 core combat system

scripts.start: prisma db push --accept-data-loss --skip-generate && node migrate-now.js && node src/bot.js
scripts.check: node --check src/bot.js src/database/client.js src/commands/create.js src/commands/profile.js src/commands/explore.js src/game/monsters.js src/game/leveling.js src/game/skills.js src/game/combat.js
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run check
